storylet.name: Assemble a Skeleton
storylet.description:
This is where you reassemble skeletons, for the edification of the public.

You prepare a manifest for purchasers:

Non-Worrying

Relatively Recent

Free of Rubbery Influence

Armless and Legless

Finless and Tentacle-Free

Buyers in the Bone Market are currently most interested in insects, which require a head, six legs, up to four wings, and no tail. Buyers with a predilection for Menacing skeletons will pay out more than usual.
storylet.teaser: This is where you reassemble skeletons, for the edification of the public...

childBranches.name: Supply a skeleton of your own
childBranches.description:
You have a steady supply of victims. One of them, stripped of flesh, might make a very handsome headless skeleton.

Your victim offers no Menace, Antiquity, or Amalgamy. It is, however, ready to hand. The skeleton will only need a skull, and can only be declared a human.

qualityRequirements.tooltip: You unlocked this by not having any Skeleton in Progress
qualityRequirements.availableAtMessage: Collect a skeletal torso and work on it in the Bone Market to develop a finished skeleton.

childBranches.name: Make something of your Thorned Ribcage
childBranches.description:
It will need a skull, four limbs, and a tail. Do not snag yourself on the thorns.

The Thorned Ribcage begins a skeleton with one point each of Menace and Amalgamy.

qualityRequirements.tooltip: You unlocked this by not having any Skeleton in Progress
qualityRequirements.availableAtMessage: Collect a skeletal torso and work on it in the Bone Market to develop a finished skeleton.
These can be found by performing excavations in Ealing Gardens, or as a rare effect in Parabola.

childBranches.name: Build on the Human Ribcage
childBranches.description:
You will be dealing with refreshingly familiar parts. One skull, four limbs, no tails.

The Human Ribcage begins a skeleton with no Menace, Antiquity, or Amalgamy. The resulting skeleton can only be declared a human, ape, or chimera.

qualityRequirements.tooltip: You unlocked this by not having any Skeleton in Progress
qualityRequirements.availableAtMessage: Collect a skeletal torso and work on it in the Bone Market to develop a finished skeleton.
You can buy these at the Bone Market for an unreasonable amount, or call in Constable Favours to receive them at the Shuttered Palace.

childBranches.name: Build on a Segmented Ribcage
childBranches.description:
The ribcage is long, sinuous, and without a taper. It would fit neatly with another of its kind.

The Segmented Ribcage begins a simple skeleton that requires only two limbs, a head, and a tail. If you begin with a Segmented Ribcage, you will be able to add more later to add more joints to your skeleton.

childBranches.name: Reassemble your Headless Humanoid
childBranches.description:
All it will need is a skull. A skull (1).

The Headless Skeleton offers no Menace, Antiquity, or Amalgamy. It can only be declared as a human or chimera.
